mapper.select: SELECT uri AS "uri", SUM(slow_count) AS "slowCount", SUM(request_count) AS "requestCount", MAX(max_request_time_ms) AS "maxRequestTimeMs", ROUND(SUM(sum_request_time_ms) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(request_count), 0), 2) AS "avgRequestTimeMs" FROM nginx_minute_stat WHERE bucket_time >= #{startTime} AND bucket_time < #{endTime} AND source_id IN #{sid} AND slow_count > 0 GROUP BY uri ORDER BY SUM(slow_count) DESC, MAX(max_request_time_ms) DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT bucket_time AS "bucketTime", SUM(request_count) AS "requestCount", SUM(status_4xx) AS "status4xx", SUM(status_5xx) AS "status5xx" FROM nginx_minute_stat WHERE bucket_time >= #{startTime} AND bucket_time < #{endTime} AND source_id IN #{sid} GROUP BY bucket_time ORDER BY bucket_time ASC
